recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, monochromatic studio portrait of a musician kneeling with an acoustic guitar, enclosed within a thick black border and set against a wide white margin featuring asymmetrical serif typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed within a secondary internal border
High contrast between dark clothing and light background
Asymmetrical text balance across the top margin
Direct eye contact creating a focal point above the horizontal guitar line
coreInvariants: Thick black internal frame with rounded corners

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically and horizontally within the inner frame; medium shot showing torso to knees.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark shirt of the subject and the soundhole of the guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large bold text at top left, across to the smaller text at top right, down to the subject's face, following the guitar neck across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the outer margin; neutral gray gradient in the studio background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white for the outer margin and highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the frame, clothing, and primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for the studio background and skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the white margin and the black frame.

letterConstructionRules: Large capital height for the primary name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Scale contrast between a bold display serif and a light, condensed body serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic, high-contrast serif look of the primary name.
Provides the elegant, traditional feel for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic studio portrait of a man with 1970s hair, wearing a dark button-down shirt and light trousers, kneeling while holding an acoustic guitar. The image should be enclosed in a thick black rectangular frame with slightly distressed edges, set against a plain white background that forms a wide outer margin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase serif text in the top left white margin. Add smaller, title-case serif text in the top right white margin, ensuring both are solid black and aligned with the top edge of the internal frame.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the subject centered within a black frame?
Is the text placed in the white margin above the frame?
Is there a clear hierarchy between the two text elements?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original titles
Any specific brand logos on the guitar headstock

mustAchieve: Professional studio lighting with soft shadows

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black frame has consistent thickness.
Check that the text does not overlap the image frame.
Verify the subject's hands and guitar strings are rendered clearly.
Confirm the background gradient is smooth without banding.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Internal Black Frame + Wide White Margin + Asymmetrical Serif Header = Classic 70s Folk Aesthetic
